@patdx/ppkg

Install binary packages on Linux and macOS from this catalog or any URL. The local CLI is ppkg (npm package @patdx/ppkg). Default remote: https://repo.pmil.me

Install the CLI once (ensure npm’s global bin directory is on your PATH):

npm install -g @patdx/ppkg@0.12.0

Example install:

ppkg add apktool

Example remove:

ppkg remove apktool

One-liner without a global install:

npx @patdx/ppkg@0.12.0 add apktool

Packages

  • apktool
  • blender
  • caddy
  • codexbar
  • duckdb
